dataList.content:
... Oi, the tosser looks right as rain again...
……喂，那家伙突然恢复原样了？

We've fought plenty of people who regenerate or heal themselves, but the way he does it seems...
虽然我们和会再生和恢复的人们交战过很多次，但这一位的方法总感觉……

... It's almost like he turned back time. Like you do, Manager.
……像是在倒流时间。就和经理您做的一样。

Naught but a futile struggle in a sealed world...
在这封闭的世界中，不过是无意义的抵抗罢了……

Ye have nowhere to flee...
汝等无处可逃了……

The candles that lay bare the sins... shall never dim...
这揭示汝等罪孽的蜡烛……绝不会熄灭……

Nor shall the pursuance of punishment for those who have sinned... ever cease...
对有罪之人施以惩罚的执行……也绝不会停止……

... I have no reason to flee. Even if a way exists.
……即便存在其他的道路，也没有理由逃跑。

O Sinful One... what is... thy purpose...?
有罪之人……汝等的目的……为何……

... To follow the Manager's judgment.
……为了遵从执行经理的判断。

The sinful one... is yet...
有罪之人仍旧……

... to comprehend... the weight of his sin...
并不领悟……其所犯之罪的重量……

Neither the order of things... nor time itself... shall stand in thy support...
秩序……与时间……都不会站在有罪之人一侧……

Never shalt thou elect... to walk the path of iniquity again...
汝等……已无法做出愚蠢之选择了……

And so, thou who hast sinned... now shall commence... thine unending penance...!
有罪之人啊……开始……无尽的告解吧……！
